title: Ivo and the Songbook
author: Juniper Coldharbour
blurb: Quentin Nystrom, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
